# Reptiles.ge

> Digital atlas of animals of Georgia: species profiles, identification, regional records, and educational safety pages. Georgian is canonical. Herpetofauna is the deepest layer.

Reptiles.ge is an editorial compilation, not a government agency and not a substitute for the papers it cites. Amphibians and reptiles follow Tarkhnishvili et al. 2026; birds, mammals, and spiders are thinner published-profile sets, not complete national checklists. Empty size, region, IUCN, or Red List fields stay hidden. Checklist candidates stay candidates. Bite and venom pages are educational: call 112; they are not medical protocol.

Use Georgian URLs below as canonical (`x-default`). Prefixed locales are `/en`, `/ru`, and `/tr`. Default-locale group paths are Georgian (`/gvelebi`); prefixed locales use English pathnames (`/en/snakes`). Species slugs are Georgian on `ka` (overrides: `giurza`, `jojo`, `gvelxokera`, `bukhrintsa`) and the catalog id on `en`/`ru`/`tr` (example: `https://reptiles.ge/en/snakes/macrovipera-lebetina`). Do not use `/ka` prefixes or unprefixed English hub paths such as `/snakes` on the default locale.

Priority order: About (methods) → 2026 herpetofauna checklist article → species atlas → group hubs and indexes → species profiles → identification and safety guides → region pages (only taxa with an administrative-unit record in the atlas).

## Core

- [Home](https://reptiles.ge/): Georgian homepage for the atlas.
- [Species atlas](https://reptiles.ge/species): Catalog of published profiles (124 live pages). Not a complete national fauna.
- [About](https://reptiles.ge/about): What the atlas is, what it will not infer, photography credits, and herpetofauna sources.
- [Georgia herpetofauna checklist 2026](https://reptiles.ge/news/georgia-herpetofauna-checklist-2026): Editorial article on Tarkhnishvili et al. 2026 (12 amphibians, 56 reptiles in that paper).

## Group hubs

- [Snakes](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi): Snake hub for Georgia (22 published species).
- [Lizards](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi): Lizard hub, including Darevskia and the glass lizard (29 published species).
- [Turtles](https://reptiles.ge/kuebi): Turtle hub (4 published taxa, including one introduced slider).
- [Amphibians](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi): Amphibian hub (12 published species).
- [Birds](https://reptiles.ge/prinvelebi): Bird hub. Published atlas profiles only — not a national avifauna list.
- [Mammals](https://reptiles.ge/dzuzumtsovrebi): Mammal hub. Published atlas profiles only — not a national mammal list.
- [Spiders](https://reptiles.ge/obobebi): Spider hub (4 published species). No separate spider index page.

## Species indexes

- [Snake index](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/saxeoebebi): Table of published snake profiles.
- [Lizard index](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/saxeoebebi): Table of published lizard profiles.
- [Turtle index](https://reptiles.ge/kuebi/saxeoebebi): Table of published turtle profiles.
- [Amphibian index](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/saxeoebebi): Table of published amphibian profiles.
- [Bird index](https://reptiles.ge/prinvelebi/saxeoebebi): Published bird profiles only.
- [Mammal index](https://reptiles.ge/dzuzumtsovrebi/saxeoebebi): Published mammal profiles only.

## Identification and field guides

- [Venomous vs harmless snakes](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/shxamiani-gvelis-amocnoba): Visual cues are not universal; compare lookalikes and profiles.
- [Lizard identification](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/identifikacia): Field marks, lookalikes, and Darevskia caution (colour is not ID).
- [Darevskia](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/darevskia): Sixteen rock-lizard profiles kept separate. Colour is not identification. Candidates stay candidates.
- [Lizard or glass lizard](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/xvlikis-da-gvelxokeras-gansxvaveba): Glass lizard vs slow worm vs snakes. None of the three is venomous on this page.
- [Turtle identification](https://reptiles.ge/kuebi/identifikacia): Four-taxon comparison (land, native freshwater, introduced slider).
- [Frogs of Georgia](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/bayayi): Anura guide (8 species in the atlas).
- [Frog index](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/bayayi/saxeoebebi): Frog and toad index table.
- [Newts and salamanders](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/tritoni-salamandra): Caudata guide (4 species in the atlas).
- [Land turtles](https://reptiles.ge/kuebi/xmelis-kuebi): Spur-thighed tortoise cluster.
- [Freshwater turtles](https://reptiles.ge/kuebi/tsqlis-kuebi): Pond turtle, Caspian turtle, and introduced slider.
- [Snake range](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/gavrtseleba): Snake occurrence across the 12 regions as recorded in the atlas.
- [Largest snakes](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/didi-gvelebi): Size only where profiles cite it. Glass lizard is a lizard.

## Safety

- [Venomous snakes in Georgia](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/shxamiani-gvelebi): Medically significant vipers in the atlas, plus identification links. Educational.
- [Snakebite](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/gvelis-nakbeni): Educational page. Call 112. Not a medical protocol and not first-aid instruction for unsupervised use.
- [Snakes in the yard](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/gveli-ezoshi): Practical notes on snakes near houses. Not a guaranteed repellent method.
- [Risk to humans](https://reptiles.ge/riskis-doneebi): What Harmless, Moderate, and High mean on atlas profiles.

## Regions

Region lists include only taxa assigned to that administrative unit in the atlas. Absence is not a national-range claim.

- [Regions](https://reptiles.ge/regions): Map of Georgia’s 12 regions used by the atlas.
- [Abkhazia](https://reptiles.ge/regions/abkhazia): Atlas records for Abkhazia.
- [Samegrelo — Zemo Svaneti](https://reptiles.ge/regions/samegrelo): Atlas records for Samegrelo — Zemo Svaneti.
- [Guria](https://reptiles.ge/regions/guria): Atlas records for Guria.
- [Adjara](https://reptiles.ge/regions/adjara): Atlas records for Adjara.
- [Imereti](https://reptiles.ge/regions/imereti): Atlas records for Imereti.
- [Racha — Lechkhumi — Kvemo Svaneti](https://reptiles.ge/regions/racha): Atlas records for Racha — Lechkhumi — Kvemo Svaneti.
- [Samtskhe — Javakheti](https://reptiles.ge/regions/samtskhe-javakheti): Atlas records for Samtskhe — Javakheti.
- [Shida Kartli](https://reptiles.ge/regions/shida-kartli): Atlas records for Shida Kartli.
- [Mtskheta — Mtianeti](https://reptiles.ge/regions/mtskheta-mtianeti): Atlas records for Mtskheta — Mtianeti.
- [Kvemo Kartli](https://reptiles.ge/regions/kvemo-kartli): Atlas records for Kvemo Kartli.
- [Kakheti](https://reptiles.ge/regions/kakheti): Atlas records for Kakheti.
- [Tbilisi](https://reptiles.ge/regions/tbilisi): Atlas records for Tbilisi.

## News

Editorial pieces with cited sources. The species profile remains the atlas record.

- [News](https://reptiles.ge/news): Index of published articles.
- [Uzzell’s lizard in Armenia](https://reptiles.ge/news/darevskia-uzzelli-armenia-2026): Field/taxonomy note related to Darevskia.
- [Dolphin strandings](https://reptiles.ge/news/georgia-dolphin-strandings-2026): Cited stranding report (not a mammal-atlas checklist).
- [Viper hybrid in the Borjomi valley](https://reptiles.ge/news/vipera-pontica-hybrid-georgia-2026): Cited hybrid record.
- [Batumi raptor count](https://reptiles.ge/news/batumi-19300-raptors-2026): Cited one-day raptor count.

## Snake species

Published snake profiles. English/Russian/Turkish slugs use the catalog id (`/en/snakes/{id}`). `dolichophis-caspius` is unpublished and is omitted.

- [Vipera dinniki](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/dinikis-gvelgesla): Dinnik’s viper. Moderate. Checklist candidate.
- [Macrovipera lebetinus](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/giurza): Levantine viper (გიურზა). High. Catalog id `macrovipera-lebetina`.
- [Vipera kaznakovi](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/kavkasiuri-gvelgesla): Caucasus viper. Moderate. Checklist candidate.
- [Vipera transcaucasiana](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/tsxvirrkosani-gvelgesla): Long-nosed viper profile (High). Catalog id `vipera-transcaucasiana`.
- [Vipera darevskii](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/darevskis-gvelgesla): Darevsky’s viper. Moderate.
- [Vipera renardi](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/velis-gvelgesla): Steppe viper. Moderate.
- [Coronella austriaca](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/spilendza): Smooth snake. Harmless.
- [Elaphe urartica](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/urartus-mtsuravi): Urartian ratsnake. Harmless.
- [Elaphe dione](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/saxeebiani-mtsuravi): Dione ratsnake. Harmless.
- [Natrix tessellata](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/tsqlis-ankara): Dice snake. Harmless.
- [Natrix natrix](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/chveulebrivi-ankara): Grass snake. Harmless.
- [Dolichophis schmidti](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/tsitelmutsela-mtsuravi): Red-bellied racer. Harmless. Checklist candidate.
- [Platyceps najadum](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/tsengosferi-mtsuravi): Dahl’s whip snake. Harmless.
- [Telescopus fallax](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/katistvala): European cat snake. Harmless.
- [Xerotyphlops vermicularis](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/gvelbrutsa): Eurasian blind snake. Harmless.
- [Eryx jaculus](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/dasavluri-maxrchobela): Javelin sand boa. Harmless.
- [Zamenis longissimus](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/eskulapis-mtsuravi): Aesculapian snake. Harmless.
- [Zamenis hohenackeri](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/amierkavkasiuri-mtsuravi): Transcaucasian ratsnake. Harmless.
- [Hemorrhois ravergieri](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/nairferi-mtsuravi): Spotted whip snake. Harmless.
- [Eirenis modestus](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/tsqnari-eirenisi): Dwarf racer. Harmless.
- [Eirenis collaris](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/saqeloiani-eirenisi): Collared dwarf racer. Harmless.
- [Malpolon insignitus](https://reptiles.ge/gvelebi/chveulebrivi-xvlikichamia-gveli): Eastern Montpellier snake. Moderate, rear-fanged. Not გიურზა.

## Lizard species

Sixteen Darevskia species are separate pages. Colour is not identification.

- [Pseudopus apodus](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/gvelxokera): European glass lizard. Harmless. Not a snake.
- [Tenuidactylus caspius](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/kaspiuri-gekoni): Caspian gecko. Harmless.
- [Anguis colchica](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/boxmecha): Eastern slow worm. Harmless. Checklist candidate.
- [Paralaudakia caucasia](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/jojo): Caucasian agama. Harmless. Catalog id `paralaudakia-caucasia`.
- [Eumeces schneiderii](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/grdzelfexa-stsinki): Schneider’s skink. Harmless.
- [Ablepharus pannonicus](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/shishveltvala-stsinki): Asian snake-eyed skink. Harmless.
- [Eremias velox](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/mardi-fsveni): Rapid racerunner. Harmless.
- [Eremias arguta](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/feradi-fsveni): Steppe-runner. Harmless.
- [Ophisops elegans](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/koxta-gveltava): Snake-eyed lizard. Harmless.
- [Lacerta agilis](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/mardi-xvliki): Sand lizard. Harmless. Checklist candidate.
- [Lacerta strigata](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/zoliani-xvliki): Striped lizard. Harmless.
- [Lacerta media](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/sashualo-xvliki): Medium lizard. Harmless. Checklist candidate.
- [Phoenicolacerta laevis](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/libanuri-xvliki): Lebanon lizard. Harmless. Introduced in the checklist.
- [Darevskia adjarica](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/acharuli-kldis-xvliki): Adjara rock lizard. Checklist candidate.
- [Darevskia alpina](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/afxazetis-kldis-xvliki): Alpine rock lizard. Checklist candidate.
- [Darevskia armeniaca](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/somxuri-kldis-xvliki): Armenian rock lizard.
- [Darevskia brauneri](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/brauneris-kldis-xvliki): Brauner’s rock lizard. Checklist candidate.
- [Darevskia caucasica](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/kavkasionis-xvliki): Caucasian rock lizard. Checklist candidate.
- [Darevskia clarkorum](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/turkuli-xvliki): Clark’s lizard.
- [Darevskia daghestanica](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/daghestnuri-xvliki): Daghestan lizard.
- [Darevskia dahli](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/dalis-xvliki): Dahl’s lizard.
- [Darevskia derjugini](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/artvinis-xvliki): Derjugin’s lizard.
- [Darevskia mixta](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/kolxuri-kldis-xvliki): Mixed rock lizard.
- [Darevskia portschinskii](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/mtkvris-xvliki): Portschinsky’s lizard.
- [Darevskia praticola](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/mdelos-xvliki): Meadow lizard.
- [Darevskia pontica](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/kolxuri-mdelos-xvliki): Pontic meadow lizard. Checklist candidate.
- [Darevskia obscura](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/mesxuri-kldis-xvliki): Meskhetian rock lizard. Checklist candidate.
- [Darevskia raddei](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/rades-xvliki): Radde’s lizard. Checklist candidate.
- [Darevskia valentini](https://reptiles.ge/xvlikebi/valentinis-xvliki): Valentin’s lizard.

## Turtle species

- [Testudo graeca](https://reptiles.ge/kuebi/xmeltashuazghvetis-ku): Spur-thighed tortoise. Harmless.
- [Emys orbicularis](https://reptiles.ge/kuebi/chaobis-ku): European pond turtle. Harmless.
- [Trachemys scripta](https://reptiles.ge/kuebi/tsitelqura-ku): Red-eared slider. Harmless. Introduced in the checklist.
- [Mauremys caspica](https://reptiles.ge/kuebi/kaspiuri-ku): Caspian turtle. Harmless.

## Amphibian species

- [Mertensiella caucasica](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/kavkasiuri-salamandra): Caucasian salamander.
- [Lissotriton lantzi](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/kavkasiuri-chveulebrivi-tritoni): Lantz’s newt. Checklist candidate.
- [Ommatotriton ophryticus](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/kavkasiuri-tritoni): Northern banded newt.
- [Triturus karelinii](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/karelinis-savartsxliani-tritoni): Karelin’s crested newt.
- [Pelobates syriacus](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/siriuli-mqvari): Eastern spadefoot.
- [Pelodytes caucasicus](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/kavkasiuri-jvriana): Caucasian parsley frog.
- [Bufotes viridis](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/mtsvane-gombesho): Green toad.
- [Bufo verrucosissimus](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/kavkasiuri-gombesho): Caucasian toad.
- [Hyla orientalis](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/aghmosavluri-vasaka): Eastern tree frog. Checklist candidate.
- [Hyla savignyi](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/mtsireaziuri-vasaka): Savigny’s tree frog.
- [Rana macrocnemis](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/mtsireaziuri-baqaqi): Long-legged wood frog.
- [Pelophylax ridibundus](https://reptiles.ge/amfibiebi/tboris-baqaqi): Marsh frog.

## Spider species

Published spider profiles only. Not a complete arachnofauna list.

- [Argiope bruennichi](https://reptiles.ge/obobebi/argiopa): Wasp spider. Harmless.
- [Argiope lobata](https://reptiles.ge/obobebi/lobebiani-argiopa): Lobed argiope. Harmless.
- [Steatoda paykulliana](https://reptiles.ge/obobebi/tsru-qaraqurti): False black widow. Harmless.
- [Latrodectus tredecimguttatus](https://reptiles.ge/obobebi/qaraqurti): Mediterranean black widow. High.

## Secondary resources

- [English](https://reptiles.ge/en): English homepage. Same catalog; English pathnames and scientific species slugs.
- [Russian](https://reptiles.ge/ru): Russian homepage (`/ru/…` + English pathnames).
- [Turkish](https://reptiles.ge/tr): Turkish homepage (`/tr/…` + English pathnames).
- [Contact](https://reptiles.ge/contact): Corrections and questions.
- [Quizzes](https://reptiles.ge/quiz): Quiz index. Turtle quiz is listed as coming soon (no URL).
- [Which snake?](https://reptiles.ge/quiz/romeli-gvelia): Snake photo quiz. Practice, not field ID. No result URLs.
- [Which lizard?](https://reptiles.ge/quiz/romeli-xvlikia): Lizard photo quiz. Practice, not field ID. No result URLs.
- [Sitemap](https://reptiles.ge/sitemap.xml): Full indexable URL set, including locale alternates.
- [Tarkhnishvili et al. 2026](https://doi.org/10.3897/caucasiana.5.e189214): Annotated checklist cited for amphibians and reptiles.
- [Iankoshvili & Tarkhnishvili 2021](https://doi.org/10.1080/09397140.2021.1957208): Snake distribution paper cited on About and some snake profiles.
